title: Ensure Consistency in Journals With Journal Check

chapters.title: Introduction to Journal Consistency and Check Options
Journal Check Fact Box and Issue Detection

features.name: Journal Check
features.description: A real-time validation feature that checks journal consistency and data integrity. Shows issues in a fact box on the journal page and provides line-level validation as you type.

features.name: Enable Data Check Setting
features.description: A configuration setting in General Ledger Setup that enables the journal check feature. When enabled, a new Journal Check fact box appears on journal pages.

features.name: Journal Check Fact Box
features.description: A UI element that appears on the right side of journal pages showing data consistency issues. Displays total issues and line-specific issues when a line is selected.
